blocks.text: Day 5 · After breakfast, your guide picks you up for a full day on the Argentine side, which is very different from the Brazilian one, with three trails. The Lower Circuit: 1,700 metres of walkways into the lush jungle, close to the Dos Hermanas, Chico and Ramírez falls, down to the foot of the Salto Bossetti, with views of the Álvar Núñez, Elenita and Lanusse falls. The Upper Circuit: 1,300 metres of elevated walkways along the edge of several major falls, with an overview of the whole area. The Devil’s Throat: the Ecological Train crosses the rainforest to Devil’s Throat Station, from where a 1,000-metre walk leads to the enormous Devil’s Throat, in a park of some 55,500 hectares. In the afternoon, your driver takes you back to your hotel.
